About the Company
We're building the AI Company Brain that superpowers intelligence across multiple industries, turning fragmented, messy operational and document-based data into a single source of truth that powers AI agents to handle full workflows.

We operate in complex, real-world B2B environments where our solutions must be reliable, scalable, and deeply integrated with our clients' operations. As we grow, engineering quality, velocity, and ownership will define our next chapter.

Role Overview
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) owns client onboarding: the technical execution of taking a signed client from contract to a fully live, working deployment. The FDE works closely with our AI and research specialists in a daily feedback loop, so what the FDE sees in the field quickly becomes systematic improvements to the product.

This is a scoped, high-leverage role: the FDE owns the client relationship and the client's live data through onboarding only. Once a client goes live, the account transfers to Customer Success, and the FDE moves on to the next onboarding. This handoff discipline is what lets onboarding scale independently of any single person's bandwidth.

Key Responsibilities

 - Run onboarding end to end, from discovery through deployment: connecting, configuring, and tuning our platform inside the client's environment, from signature through go-live

 - Build integrations with client systems (ERPs, WMS, TMS, data warehouses), writing real code to connect, extract, and transform data across environments

 - Own the client's live data integrity throughout onboarding, working exclusively with real client data

 - Give daily, direct feedback on agent behavior so what breaks in the field gets fixed in the product, not patched locally

 - Close every onboarding with a clean handoff: promised use cases live in production, integrations running with no manual work, agents performing at the agreed quality bar, and the client's team trained and operating on their own

 - Hand off and move on: once Customer Success accepts the account, it's theirs end to end, and the FDE's job is the next onboarding, not maintaining the last one

Profile We're Looking For

 - You build things: 2–4 years of hands-on engineering experience (Python, REST APIs, SQL) and a portfolio of real integrations or systems you've shipped, not just designed

 - You operate in ambiguity: comfortable walking into a client environment without a complete spec, asking the right questions, and figuring out what needs to be built without waiting for perfect requirements

 - You understand data end to end: how it flows across systems, where it breaks, and what it takes to make it clean and reliable enough for AI to use; SQL or equivalent is second nature

 - You have a working understanding of AI and LLMs: enough to design prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when a model result looks right but isn't

 - You communicate clearly across audiences: you can explain a technical integration to a VP of Operations and write clean documentation for an engineer, in both Spanish and English

 - You finish what you start, then let go: high accountability during onboarding, and equally disciplined about handing off clean; you don't hang on to an account past go-live, and you don't patch locally what should be fixed in the product

 - Available to work across time zones and travel to client sites when needed

Nice to Have

 - Background in operations or complex B2B environments: you'll pick up a client's operational language quickly, without needing a glossary

 - Experience integrating with enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, or similar ERPs and WMS platforms

 - Previous experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical role
